events.title: Fox Logo Throughout the Clip
must_haves: The video shows the same woman at the kitchen table, with the source framing and sequence preserved.
The supplied orange-hoodie fox appears in the top-right corner from the first frame through the last frame.
The fox has no visible white rectangular background and is not clipped at the frame edges.
The logo remains small and does not obscure the woman's face.
The original speech remains audible and synchronized throughout the 10-second clip.

answer_sheet.Logo asset and treatment: Use mascot-fox.png, removing the white background without removing parts of the fox.
answer_sheet.Logo position, size, and timing: Top-right corner with a small inset, visible throughout all 10 seconds; small enough not to cover the woman's face.
answer_sheet.Video framing and sound: Keep the source aspect ratio, framing, timing, and original speech. No new music or text.
